title: Edit the GET /bootstrap handler in repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts so that identity_endpoint and discovery_endpoint
description: Edit the GET /bootstrap handler in repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts so that identity_endpoint and discovery_endpoint are derived from the incoming request's own origin instead of falling back to a loopback URL or an empty string. Keep the existing explicit env override as the highest precedence: process.env.IDENTITY_PUBLIC_URL for identity_endpoint and process.env.DISCOVERY_PUBLIC_URL for discovery_endpoint, and keep the PUBLIC_IP derivation below that. When neither of those yields a value, build the endpoint from the scheme, host and port the client demonstrably just reached this server on: prefer the X-Forwarded-Proto header over the request URL scheme and prefer the X-Forwarded-Host header over the Host header, using c.req.header to read them, and assemble the origin as scheme plus '://' plus host. That origin is by construction routable from the client that sent the request, so use it for discovery_endpoint directly and for identity_endpoint combine that same host with the identity port from process.env.IDENTITY_PUBLIC_PORT defaulting to 18101. Delete the process.env.IDENTITY_VESSEL_URL fallback entirely, because a loopback address handed to a remote caller is an unroutable answer that reads as success. Because the response body now varies with the request headers, the handler must not be cached across different clients: set a Vary response header listing Host and X-Forwarded-Host before returning. Finally, when no honest anchor can be produced at all, meaning both the env overrides and the request-origin derivation come up empty, the handler must say so in the body rather than returning a plain 200 that looks successful: add an explicit boolean field named anchors_resolved set to false and a string field named unresolved_reason naming which of identity_endpoint or discovery_endpoint could not be anchored, and return that body with HTTP status 503. When anchors are resolved, set anchors_resolved to true and keep the existing relay_multiaddrs and prefer_transport fields unchanged.
